title: After Michigan Loss, AIPAC Weighs a Second Effort to Defeat El-Sayed
summary: The pro-Israel organization spent $32 million in an unsuccessful effort to defeat Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan’s Democratic Senate primary. It might try again in the general election.
